plugin.note: Jellies attack with magic-based melee - Protect from Melee negates all damage. In multicombat areas Ice Burst or Ice Barrage is the fastest method; the Venator bow is a lower-effort alternative.

requirements: 52 Slayer and 57 combat are required for Jellies assignments.
Bigger and Badder unlocks Vitreous Jelly superior spawns.
The Heart of Darkness is required for the Ruins of Tapoyauik.
Krystilia assignments must be completed in the Wilderness.
mechanics: Jellies attack with magic-based melee; Protect from Melee negates all damage taken.
Jellies have an unusually high Defence level compared to similar-level monsters.
Chilled Jellies are 50% susceptible to fire spells.
The Wilderness Slayer Cave is a player killing hotspot.

methods.label: Melee with Protect from Melee
methods.summary: Camp Protect from Melee and kill Jellies with a strong stab or crush weapon.
requiredOrKeyItems: Ghrazi rapier, Inquisitor's mace, or Blade of saeldor
steps: Turn on Protect from Melee to negate all Jelly damage.
Kill Warped Jellies in the Catacombs of Kourend for the better loot table when possible.

methods.label: Ice Burst/Barrage in the Catacombs
methods.summary: Lure Warped Jellies in the multicombat Catacombs of Kourend and kill them with multi-target Ancient Magicks for the fastest kills.
requiredOrKeyItems: Ice Burst or Ice Barrage runes
steps: Lure a pile of Warped Jellies in the multicombat Catacombs.
Burst or barrage the pile while praying Protect from Melee.
Collect ancient shards and dark totem pieces.

methods.label: Venator bow ranged
methods.summary: Use the Venator bow's ricochet in multicombat areas as a lower-effort alternative to Magic.
steps: Attack clumped Jellies so the Venator bow's ricochet hits multiple targets.
Expect slower kills than Magic but significantly less effort.

methods.label: Wilderness Slayer Cave
methods.summary: Complete Krystilia assignments at the Wilderness Slayer Cave with minimal risk gear and an escape teleport.
requiredOrKeyItems: One-click teleport such as a royal seed pod
Cheap gear you are willing to lose
risks: The Wilderness Slayer Cave is a popular player killing hotspot.
steps: Bring only what you are willing to lose.
Keep a one-click teleport ready and escape on sight of player killers.
A cannon can be used but is at risk.

methods.label: Vitreous Jelly superiors
methods.summary: Handle Vitreous Jellies as stronger superiors with no special mechanics while keeping Protect from Melee up.
steps: Keep Protect from Melee on - superiors also use magic-based melee.
Expect max hits of 17-19 but no additional mechanics.

styleOptions.label: Melee
styleOptions.summary: Primary melee setup with a high-accuracy weapon against the high Defence.

styleOptions.label: Ancient Magicks burst
styleOptions.summary: Multi-target Ancient Magicks for multicombat areas.

styleOptions.label: Venator bow
styleOptions.summary: Low-effort ranged alternative in multicombat areas.

body:
# Jellies

Jellies attack with magic-based melee, so Protect from Melee negates all damage. Melee with a high-accuracy weapon is the simple default; in the multicombat Catacombs of Kourend, Ice Burst or Ice Barrage Warped Jellies for the fastest kills, or use the Venator bow for a lower-effort task. Krystilia assignments are completed at the Wilderness Slayer Cave.
